content_text: Virtual support for new families Navigate your baby’s first few months of life with guidance from early childhood coaches, developmental experts, and Kinedu. Apply today to join Kinedu’s newest program, Kinedu Online. Benefits to joining Kinedu Online: - Support your child’s development and education from home with expert coaching and the Kinedu App as a guide. - Keep track of your child’s progress and identify upcoming milestones. - Get direct support from early childhood specialists on topics like breastfeeding, sleep, child nutrition, and parenting. - Access to the world’s leading developmental app, Kinedu, and all of its content, including daily activity plans, articles, progress reports, and more. How can you join? Apply here by filling out an application. If you are selected, we will schedule an interview with you, so you can also get to know us and we can get to know you! Apply by January 15, 2021. How will it work? After being accepted to the first cohort of Kinedu Online families, your journey begins! Every day, your developmental coach will send you between 2 to 4 video activities via the Kinedu App. You will also be asked to attend to two live group clases hosted by your coach or guest speakers. Based on your child’s reported progress, included milestone completion, your coach will be able to suggest personalized activity recommendations designed to help your child develop and reinforce specific skills. Once a month you will also have the opportunity to schedule a one-on-one meeting with your coach to discuss the progress your child has made and discuss any questions or concerns you have about your child’s development. As part of the Kinedu Online program, you’ll also receive exclusive access to early childhood development partner programs and have the opportunity to hear from experts on topics such as sleep, nutrition, positive parenting, and more! Apply today! Application deadline: January 15, 2021 Learn more about the program here
